title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Numbers 5: keeping the camp clean, restitution for wrongs, and the law of jealousy with the water of bitterness.

questions.text: Besides every leper and everyone with a discharge, who was to be put out of the camp?
questions.explanation: Yahweh commanded that every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse be put out of the camp.

answers.text: Every foreigner living among them
Whoever is unclean by a corpse
Everyone who broke the Sabbath
Every widow without family

questions.text: Why were the unclean to be put outside of the camp?
questions.explanation: Both male and female were put outside so that they would not defile the camp, in the midst of which Yahweh dwells.

answers.text: So the priests could count them separately
Because the camp had grown too crowded
So they would not defile the camp where Yahweh dwells
So they could guard the camp at night

questions.text: When a guilty person confessed his sin and made restitution for his guilt, what was to be added to it?
questions.explanation: The guilty person had to confess, make restitution in full, and add to it the fifth part of it.

answers.text: A fifth part
A tenth part
Double the amount
Half the amount

questions.text: If the wronged man had no kinsman to receive the restitution, to whom did it go?
questions.explanation: If there was no kinsman, the restitution made to Yahweh was to be the priest's, in addition to the ram of the atonement.

answers.text: The elders of the tribe
The poor of the camp
The guilty man's own family
The priest

questions.text: What offering did a jealous husband bring for his wife?
questions.explanation: He brought one tenth of an ephah of barley meal, with no oil or frankincense on it, because it was a meal offering of jealousy.

answers.text: Fine flour mixed with oil and frankincense
One tenth of an ephah of barley meal
Two turtledoves or two young pigeons
A male lamb a year old without defect

questions.text: What did the priest put into the holy water in the earthen vessel?
questions.explanation: The priest took some of the dust that was on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

answers.text: Ashes from the altar of burnt offering
Salt from the meal offerings
Blood from the ram of atonement
Dust from the floor of the tabernacle

questions.text: What did the priest do with the woman's hair when he set her before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The priest set the woman before Yahweh and let the hair of her head go loose.

answers.text: He let it go loose
He shaved it off
He covered it with a veil
He cut off one lock

questions.text: What did the woman say in response to the oath of cursing?
questions.explanation: After the priest spoke the curse, the woman was to say, "Amen, Amen."

answers.text: "Let it be as you say"
"I am innocent"
"Amen, Amen"
"Yahweh is my witness"

questions.text: What did the priest do with the curses after writing them in a book?
questions.explanation: The priest wrote the curses in a book and wiped them into the water of bitterness.

answers.text: He burned them on the altar
He wiped them into the water of bitterness
He read them aloud to the people
He gave them to the husband

questions.text: According to the law, what would happen to the woman if she was not defiled?
questions.explanation: If the woman was not defiled but clean, she would be free and would conceive offspring.

answers.text: She would have to stay outside the camp for seven days
She would bring a ram as a trespass offering
Her husband would pay her a fifth part
She would be free and conceive offspring
